van_de: YOLO26 goi tuk-tuk/ba gac la car/truck, con YOLOE sinh 2-3 box chong nhau (1 box mai bạt, 1 box thung xe, 1 box ca xe)
quyet_dinh: Xoa cac box con cua YOLOE, chi giu 1 box three_wheeler duy nhat om tron ca khung xe, banh xe va mai bat gan lien
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 2 va 4.1: Moi xe ba banh (tuk-tuk, xich lo, ba gac) chi gan 1 box three_wheeler duy nhat bao gom ca mui/thung co dinh; xoa box con trung lap

van_de: Cau hoi mo #2 (muc 6 v1.0): Khoi xe may do day dac gan camera thi gan tung xe hay ignore_region?
quyet_dinh: Neu xe cao >= 20px va nhin thay >= 20% dien tich (nhu hang xe tien canh img_006) thi bat buoc gan tung motorbike; chi dung ignore_region khi cum >= 5 xe bi che khuat > 80% hoac cao < 20px o xa (nhu img_018)
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 2 va 4.1.6: Khong dung ignore_region cho hang xe may do gan camera neu tung xe cao >= 20px va thay >= 20% dien tich

van_de: Cau hoi mo #3 va #5 (muc 6 v1.0): Hang hoa nho ra tren xe va kinh chan gio/phan nguoi lai trong mask SAM
quyet_dinh: Voi box: giu nguyen khung xe va ro/thung gan co dinh (nhu img_031), khong keo box theo hang nho ra > 20% chieu dai xe; voi mask SAM (img_013, img_003): kinh xe thuoc mask xe nhung nguoi lai/khach phai dung click am (--neg) de tach rieng khoi mask xe
quy_tac_ghi_vao_guideline: Muc 4.1.5 va 4.2.3: Hang nho > 20% khong tinh vao box/mask xe; mask three_wheeler gom kinh xe nhung loai tru nguoi ngoi tren xe

van_de: Lot 3 bay (img_035 missing motorbike, img_024 loose motorbike, img_027 wrong_class person->bicycle) va con box dau nguoi trung lap (#572 trong #578 tren img_035)
